title: Not for every-last-drop people.
text:
Not for every-last-drop people.. It is relatively space efficient and does well at holding beverages.

Where it falls flat is in pouring the beverages. There is a huge lip between the body and the pour spout, which means you'll have to turn the pitcher completely upside down to get all the contents out of it.

Also, the lid consists of 4 part: Rubber ring, 2 plastic pieces that squeeze the ring and a third plastic piece that holds the two main plastic pieces together. Not terribly difficult to use, but a little tougher to take apart for cleaning.

I won't return them, but I won't be buying them again either.
